en: A black and white image of a large cloister or monastery complex surrounded by a wooded area. The architecture features Baroque or early modern European style, with several towers, domes, and a courtyard visible. In the bottom right corner, there is an inset or separate photograph of a nun in traditional habit, standing in an arched doorway. The handwritten caption at the bottom identifies the site.
